reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in applying REINFORCE with a variance-bounded greedy baseline to mine steady formulaic alphas. The baseline reduces variance through subtractive estimation, improving convergence and stability. IR reward shaping encourages long-term factor robustness by rewarding information ratios over time, not just immediate IC spikes. The Dirac-MDP framework assumes deterministic transitions, simplifying policy updates and aligning with structured financial data. These primitives form a dual mechanism: one ensuring signal stability (variance bound) and another promoting regime-invariant performance (IR shaping). The failure mode occurs when the greedy baseline fails to approximate true expected returns, or when IR shaping overfits to training windows. In GSE, this manifests as overfitting to specific volatility regimes; in GSI, it leads to unreliable uncertainty bounds.
